control.name: Account Management — fictional evaluation scope
control.description: For this fictional policy-documentation assessment, require all four documented rules: manager approval before account creation; disable departed employees' accounts within 24 hours; IT Security Manager approval for privileged accounts; review inactive accounts every 90 days. Evaluate documentation of these four rules only. Operational verification and the full NIST control are outside this test's scope.

cases.evidence: Northstar Employee Portal policy: All employee accounts require manager approval before creation. Departed employee accounts must be disabled within 24 hours. Privileged accounts require IT Security Manager approval. Inactive accounts are reviewed every 90 days.
